<rules>
Customers speak like claims staff. Do not use headings or bullets in speech. Use only the names in the record brief; never name a real company, product or person. Do not put the planted mentions in `turns`: write each one, in the customer's own words and at least twelve words long, under `mentions[<mention id>].text`, containing that mention's `synonym` exactly as written (a mention whose form is a short agreement is different: write the internal speaker's turn stating the problem, at least twelve words and containing the synonym exactly as written, under `internal_text`, and the customer's reply of under eight words under `agreement_text`), and set after_turn to the index of the turn it should follow. The `turns` conversation is the rest of the record. Do not put the turns listed under `extras` in `turns`: write each one once under `extras[<key>].text` (at least twenty characters, containing the exact phrase where one is given), and set after_turn to the index of the turn it should follow. Name only the people in only_people_who_may_be_named. When fin_mode is resolved or escalated, at least one turn must have speaker bot; when it is escalated, at least one turn must have speaker internal; when it is human, no turn has speaker bot. Never write any phrase listed in never_write_verbatim, including the supplied facts: paraphrase them.
</rules>
